question: What sum of money (in ₹) will amount to ₹2,400 at 4% per annum simple interest in 5 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective interest rate for 5 years = 4% × 5 = 20%.

Total amount in percentage = 100% (Principal) + 20% (Interest) = 120%.

Given that 120% of the principal corresponds to ₹2,400.

Principal (100%) = (2400 ÷ 120) × 100 = 20 × 100 = 2000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,000.**
